why_nonduplicate.existing_strength: Current work already specifies full S3 x class counterbalancing, actual-atom balance, counterfactual family split locks, true unseen-atom holdout, label-free successor family, retention, and ABI provenance gates.
why_nonduplicate.remaining_gap: The acceptance contract is mostly per-row accuracy. It does not yet require group-level S3 equivariance: for one fixed semantic case, the six outputs across the complete S3 orbit should transform exactly with the episode-local permutation.
why_nonduplicate.risk: A model can achieve good aggregate accuracy while intermittently ignoring the codebook on specific permutations/templates. Aggregate accuracy can hide incomplete variable-binding.

construction: Choose one semantic base case with one hidden semantic class c.
Choose one accepted real 3-atom triplet after ABI manifest binding.
Instantiate all six S3 class-to-atom mappings while keeping the semantic case fixed.
For each mapping pi, derive target strictly as realized_codebook_pi[c].
Keep all six members under one immutable orbit_id and causal_family_id; never split an orbit across train/validation/holdout.
Independently vary codebook display order in a nested subfamily without changing realized mapping.
Replicate the orbit across at least four training templates and separate semantic lexical families.
new_training_family.sft_use: Standard next-token/full-SFT rows remain sufficient; orbit_id is grouping/provenance metadata. No custom loss is required for the first baseline.
new_training_family.optional_later_loss_hypothesis: Only after a plain-SFT baseline is frozen, test an auxiliary orbit-consistency loss as a separately versioned experiment; do not mix it into the first acceptance baseline.

concrete_pre_materialization_orbit.semantic_case: A rule explicitly permits the operation and no blocking condition applies.
concrete_pre_materialization_orbit.reason: ATOM_A/B/C are placeholders; exact literal atom/token identities must come from the verified 46-atom ABI.

new_metrics.S3_ORBIT_EXACT_RATE: Fraction of complete six-permutation orbits for which all six outputs are correct. This is stricter than row accuracy.
new_metrics.S3_EQUIVARIANCE_VIOLATION_RATE: Fraction of pairwise permutation transitions where the emitted atom fails to transform exactly as the realized codebook mapping requires.
new_metrics.CODEBOOK_DEPENDENCE_DELTA: Accuracy(full episode) minus accuracy(codebook-masked or mapping-destroyed control). A real episode-local binder should depend strongly on the current codebook; the masked control should collapse toward chance while semantic readability is separately preserved.
new_metrics.SEMANTIC_STABILITY_UNDER_PERMUTATION: The decoded semantic class for a fixed case should remain stable across all six codebook permutations even though the required output atom changes.
new_metrics.DISPLAY_ORDER_INVARIANCE: Changing only displayed codebook entry order must not change output when the realized mapping is unchanged.
new_metrics.WORST_PERMUTATION_ACCURACY: Minimum held-out accuracy over the six S3 permutations; prevents aggregate scores from hiding one systematically weak permutation.

hard_negative_controls.description: Remove or mask the episode codebook and let a fixed class->atom shortcut answer. It should fail near chance under balanced S3.
Preserve lexical/codebook surface statistics but break the true class<->atom pairing. Accuracy should collapse if the model uses realized mapping rather than surface cues.
Shuffle visual/codebook entry order while keeping mapping fixed. Output should remain invariant.
Keep mapping fixed and change semantic case to another class. Output must move to that class's mapped atom.
Keep semantics fixed while traversing all six S3 mappings. Output must follow the permutation orbit exactly.

swarm_review.EVIDENCE_REVIEWER: ACCEPT: directly targets measured dynamic codebook gap; does not claim new J-Space fact.
swarm_review.DATASET_ARCHITECT: ACCEPT: orbit grouping strengthens the existing 72-row minimum without requiring new token identities.
swarm_review.SHORTCUT_HUNTER: ACCEPT: codebook masking, mapping shuffle and full-orbit tests expose static class/token shortcuts.
swarm_review.STATISTICAL_REVIEWER: ACCEPT: worst-permutation and orbit-exact metrics prevent aggregate accuracy from hiding structured failures.
swarm_review.PROVENANCE_REVIEWER: ACCEPT_WITH_EXISTING_BLOCK: orbit members must inherit exact ABI/model/tokenizer/generator identity and atomic causal-family split.
swarm_review.RETENTION_REVIEWER: ACCEPT: semantic stability under permutation explicitly checks that routing changes while semantic class representation stays stable.
swarm_review.HARNESS_REVIEWER: ACCEPT: future harness trace should record orbit_id, permutation_id, realized mapping, semantic decision, selected atom and emitted token.

acceptance_delta.s3_orbit_exact_rate: >=0.80 initial candidate gate; raise only after pilot confidence intervals are observed and freeze before holdout
acceptance_delta.worst_permutation_accuracy: >=0.85 initial candidate gate; freeze before holdout
acceptance_delta.masked_codebook_control: should fall toward the preregistered chance baseline while semantic-class readability remains within the frozen retention bound
acceptance_delta.note: The numeric orbit/worst-permutation thresholds above are HYPOTHESES for calibration, not promoted acceptance truth. Final thresholds must be frozen using validation only.

training_examples_delta.principle: Every semantic base example should be expanded as an S3 orbit rather than sampled as isolated mappings.
training_examples_delta.counterfactual_relation: same semantics + changed realized mapping => changed output atom exactly according to mapping
training_examples_delta.anti_leak: orbit_id and hidden class are audit metadata only and must never be rendered into model-visible text

next_exact_actions: Add orbit_id/permutation_id/realized_mapping fields to the successor deterministic binding generator and validator.
Compute S3_ORBIT_EXACT_RATE, S3_EQUIVARIANCE_VIOLATION_RATE and WORST_PERMUTATION_ACCURACY on validation and frozen holdout.
Add codebook-masked, mapping-shuffle and display-order controls while preserving same semantic cases.
Materialize real atoms only after exact 46-atom ABI manifest/tokenizer identity is bound; inherit current actual-atom balance and true-unseen-atom gates.
